qualifier: NK and NKT cell differentiation and proliferation
name: IL-15/IL-21 driven NK and NKT cell development
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 cytokine signaling and the NK/NKT cell differentiation, proliferation and activation it drives; the NKT cell terms separate it from IL-2/7, IL-10/12/23/27 and TNF-inflammatory cytokine neighbours.

qualifier: FLT3 signaling via CBL, SRC kinases and STAT5
name: RUNX transcription programs and FLT3–CBL–STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are RUNX1/2/3-regulated hematopoietic and lineage transcription plus FLT3 receptor signaling and its CBL/SRC/STAT5 branches; the pairing distinguishes it from RUNX-only, FLT3-fusion-only and interleukin-receptor neighbours.

core: TGF-beta regulation of fibroblast-driven tissue repair
name: TGF-beta–SMAD signaling regulation of fibroblast-driven tissue repair
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 signaling and its downregulation together with fibroblast, myofibroblast, ECM and connective tissue replacement outputs; the SMAD signaling core is what the fibrosis and cardiac-muscle neighbours lack.

core: Calcium-dependent regulation of striated muscle contraction
name: Ryanodine receptor calcium release control of striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels to control cardiac and skeletal contraction, relaxation and rate; neighbours concern SERCA/calcium import and positive inotropy rather than release-channel control.

core: B cell migration and lymphoid organ positioning
name: Sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor–guided B cell positioning in lymphoid tissue
rationale: Members are S1P receptor signaling, B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone B cell differentiation and lymph node development; S1P and B cell focus separate it from CXCR4, T cell homing and GALT neighbours.

name: Autophagosome assembly, maturation and selective cargo targeting
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome formation and maturation and deliver selective cargo (mitochondria, microbes, synaptic proteins); neighbours instead emphasize lysosome and endosome fusion or reticulophagy.

qualifier: depolarization-repolarization phases 0–3 in atrial, ventricular and Purkinje cells
name: Atrial, ventricular and Purkinje action potential phases 0–3
rationale: Members are the depolarization, plateau and repolarization phases of working-myocardium and His-Purkinje action potentials; neighbours center on resting potential and K+ channels or SA-node pacemaking and gap-junction coupling.

name: Cardiolipin and phosphatidylglycerol synthesis from CDP-diacylglycerol
rationale: All members are CDP-DAG, PG and cardiolipin synthesis or remodeling; neighbours cover PA, DAG/TAG or PC synthesis instead.

name: Thiamine and riboflavin metabolism and membrane transport
rationale: Members are vitamin B1 and B2 metabolism and transmembrane transport; neighbours concern carnitine/choline, coenzyme A or cobalamin.

qualifier: trans-Golgi network to endosome and lysosome routes
name: Trans-Golgi network to endosome and lysosome trafficking
rationale: Members are TGN vesicle biogenesis, Golgi-endosome exchange and lysosomal protein delivery; neighbours center on COPI, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic.

core: White adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
name: PPARG-regulated white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development
rationale: Members are white fat cell differentiation/proliferation, adipose and fat pad development and PPAR(G) signaling control; neighbours involve thermogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha circadian or LXR lipid metabolism.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme maintenance and mesenchymal-to-epithelial tubule differentiation
rationale: Members are metanephric mesenchyme maintenance/differentiation and its epithelialization into nephron tubules; neighbours cover kidney size, nephron segment patterning or ureteric bud and nephric duct formation.

name: Synaptic endosomal trafficking of postsynaptic AMPA receptors
rationale: Members are endosome-based recycling of synaptic vesicles and postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors, including GluR2-AMPA trafficking and postsynaptic actin; neighbours are presynaptic active-zone, BDNF or AMPA clustering themes.

name: Phospholipase-driven glycerophospholipid catabolism and endocannabinoid lipid signaling
rationale: Members hydrolyze phospholipids, lysophospholipids, DAG/MAG and NAPE/NAE and include endocannabinoid retrograde signaling; neighbours are phospholipid synthesis/remodeling or glycerol metabolism.

name: Trophoblast lineage and placental labyrinth development in pregnancy
rationale: Members are trophectoderm/ICM specification, trophoblast differentiation, migration and endoreduplication, labyrinth and chorio-allantoic development and decidualization; neighbours concern mammary gland, gonads or germline stem cells.

name: Drug-of-abuse response and reward conditioning
rationale: Members are cocaine, amphetamine and isoquinoline alkaloid responses, conditioned place preference, operant conditioning and DARPP-32; neighbours are dopamine receptor signaling, opioid neuropeptides or general behaviours.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body localization
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding and telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members are CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of actin and tubulin plus telomerase holoenzyme assembly and scaRNA/telomerase Cajal body localization; folding-only neighbours lack the telomerase arm and the rRNA neighbour lacks folding.

qualifier: SIRP-mediated inhibition of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation
name: Myeloid inflammatory activation and SIRP-mediated phagocyte restraint
rationale: Members are monocyte/DC/neutrophil inflammatory and TLR responses together with SIRP interactions and negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation; neighbours emphasize respiratory burst, degranulation or heme/oxLDL signaling.

name: Mitochondrial translation and respiratory complex assembly
rationale: Members are mitochondrial translation initiation/elongation/termination, inner-membrane insertion and assembly of complexes I, III, IV and ATP synthase; neighbours cover electron transport, ATP synthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly without translation.

core: Cellular cholesterol efflux and HDL assembly
name: Macrophage cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell formation
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, storage and import, HDL/ABCA1 assembly and oxLDL-driven foam cell differentiation; neighbours concern lipoprotein remodeling/clearance, intestinal absorption or SREBP/LDL receptor control.

qualifier: positive and negative selection and self-tolerance
name: Thymic T cell selection and thymocyte development
rationale: Members are thymocyte proliferation, survival, migration, differentiation and positive/negative selection; neighbours concern bone marrow hematopoiesis and B cell differentiation.

qualifier: anterograde and retrograde in cilium assembly
name: Intraflagellar anterograde and retrograde transport in cilia
rationale: All members are IFT within cilia; neighbours cover ciliary cargo targeting, cilium disassembly or basal body/centriole organization.

qualifier: nitric oxide synthase and oxidoreductase regulation
name: Ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism in redox enzyme regulation
rationale: Members are vitamin C and BH4 metabolism/transport with regulation of NOS, oxidoreductase and superoxide removal; neighbours concern NADPH/ROS detoxification, iron handling or xenobiotic responses and lack BH4/NOS.

core: Myoblast and satellite cell expansion in muscle regeneration
name: Satellite cell self-renewal and restraint of myogenic differentiation
rationale: Members are satellite cell maintenance, myoblast proliferation/migration and negative regulation of myoblast, myotube and muscle development; neighbours promote myogenic differentiation and fusion or concern atrophy.

name: Ig-superfamily heterophilic adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are DSCAM, sidekick and nectin heterophilic recognition and DSCAM-mediated dendrite self-avoidance; neighbours concern L1/NCAM, ephrin, netrin guidance or nodal axon domains.
